title: Fixed Returning Pipe and Twin Counterarm Pedestal
description: One wholly newly authored complete fixed marine-loading-arm-inspired exterior. A broad whole annular foot and tall annular pedestal sleeve surround a full rising pipe. That single continuous finite-thickness hollow tube bends into a long upward inner reach, a returning outer reach and an obliquely forward/downturned open terminal with a complete annular flange; inner walls, outer walls and both finite end rims are all modeled. Three pairs of distinct lateral trunnion stubs and full circular caps sit outside the tube bore. Separate paired lower and upper rear counterarms extend from two different elbow regions to two independent complete rectangular counterweight masses, with full root trunnion supports. Unlike the railway reservoir and spout tower, there is no elevated tank, four-post trestle, upper pulley or hanging counterweight cord. Unlike the concrete-pump truck there is no vehicle, separate three-link carrying boom, hopper or deployed outriggers; the continuous returning pipe and two rear counterarm assemblies define this whole pedestal apparatus. All numeric pipe, feet, sleeve, lateral pivots, arms and masses authored together, no old spout, truck pipe, crane boom or industrial robot imported or extracted. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up, whole horizontal bounds centred over the complete annular ground sole, one prop zero scenes. The lower mouth lies inside the ground foot and is hidden by the display ground; only the elevated outlet is intended to be visually inspected. Dry fixed illustrative art only, without ship, hose, fuel, chemicals or transfer connection. No fluid service, pressure, sealing, bore-network suitability, swivel-joint rotation, articulating travel, counterbalance solution, actuation, mooring, loading, manufacture, installation, operation or marine safety capability made or verified. No rigging, animation or interaction.
